Remarks

This builder aggregates validation messages per field and produces a list of ApiErrorItem instances suitable for API responses.

ValidationErrorBuilder

Remarks

If an error entry for the specified field already exists, the message is appended to its message collection. Otherwise, a new error entry is created.
